issues.description: The template Stock class declares findStockIngredient with two parameters (String name, boolean caseSensitive), while the problem statement's UML and the solution use a single-parameter signature findStockIngredient(String). Meanwhile, other methods in the template (add and take) call findStockIngredient with a single String argument. This mismatch causes a compilation error and prevents students from building the project or following the intended API described in the exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Stock class to provide a single-parameter method findStockIngredient(String name) that matches the UML in the problem statement and the solution. Concretely, replace or overload the existing findStockIngredient(String name, boolean caseSensitive) with public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) (case-sensitive or case-insensitive behavior as per the UML/solution). This will align the template, problem description, and solution and allow add/take calls to compile.
